name: manual_bae746
claim: Translate CLI actions into separate GUI preview, operator proof, apply, and durable receipt states; confirmation is not authorization and an absent receipt does not permit replay.

decisions.notes: Orama #534 adds a reducer and relay types, not a wired verifier or activation. A button hold, cookie, or shared host identity does not prove the operator. Keep proof opaque, invalidate changed previews, and reconcile unknown attempts with read-only requests.

rationale: Orama #534 adds a reducer and relay types, not a wired verifier or activation. A button hold, cookie, or shared host identity does not prove the operator. Keep proof opaque, invalidate changed previews, and reconcile unknown attempts with read-only requests.
